title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Daniel 7: the four great animals from the sea, the ten horns and the little horn, the ancient of days, and one like a son of man.

questions.text: In the first year of which king did Daniel have this dream and these visions?
questions.explanation: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed, and he wrote the dream down.

answers.text: Belshazzar king of Babylon
Darius the Mede
Cyrus king of Persia
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

questions.text: What came up from the great sea in the vision?
questions.explanation: The four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea, and four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

answers.text: Four chariots of fire from the sky
A great image of gold and silver
Four great animals, different from one another
Ten horns rising without a head

questions.text: What was the first animal like?
questions.explanation: The first was like a lion and had eagle's wings, and Daniel watched until its wings were plucked and it was made to stand on two feet as a man.

answers.text: Like a bear raised up on one side
Like a lion with eagle's wings
Like a leopard with four heads
Like a ram with two high horns

questions.text: What was in the mouth of the second animal, which was like a bear?
questions.explanation: The second animal was like a bear, raised up on one side, with three ribs in its mouth between its teeth.

answers.text: Great iron teeth
A little horn with eyes
Four wings of a bird
Three ribs

questions.text: What did the animal like a leopard have?
questions.explanation: The animal like a leopard had four wings of a bird on its back and four heads, and dominion was given to it.

answers.text: Ten horns and iron teeth
Eagle's wings and a man's heart
Four wings of a bird and four heads
Two horns, one higher than the other

questions.text: What did the fourth animal have?
questions.explanation: The fourth animal was awesome, powerful and exceedingly strong, with great iron teeth, and it had ten horns.

answers.text: Great iron teeth and ten horns
Three ribs between its teeth
Four heads and four wings
A notable horn between its eyes

questions.text: How is the one who is ancient of days described as he sat down?
questions.explanation: His clothing was white as snow, the hair of his head was like pure wool, his throne was fiery flames and its wheels burning fire.

answers.text: Clothed in linen, with thighs of pure gold
With a face like lightning and eyes like torches
Crowned with ten horns and a mouth speaking great things
His clothing white as snow and his hair like pure wool

questions.text: Who came with the clouds of the sky to the ancient of days?
questions.explanation: One like a son of man came with the clouds of the sky to the ancient of days, and dominion, glory and a kingdom were given to him.

answers.text: A watcher and a holy one
One like a son of man
The little horn with eyes
Michael, one of the chief princes

questions.text: What was Daniel told that the four great animals are?
questions.explanation: Daniel was told that the four great animals are four kings who will arise out of the earth, but that the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever.

answers.text: Four kings who will arise out of the earth
Four winds that broke out on the sea
Four kingdoms that have already fallen
Four messengers sent from the thrones

questions.text: What will the one who speaks words against the Most High plan to change?
questions.explanation: He will speak words against the Most High, wear out the saints of the Most High, and plan to change the times and the law, and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

answers.text: The names of the tribes of Israel
The borders of the four kingdoms
The times and the law
The writing of truth
